caption: Giardino degli Aranci, Rome
composition: Aventine orange-garden terrace with pines overlooking St. Peter’s dome · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The orange-tree avenue runs down the left of the frame, fruit-heavy branches and tall umbrella pines shading the gravel path where a few visitors stroll, with the stone parapet wall at the center leading the eye to the right. Beyond it Rome spreads out below, St. Peter's dome rising clear above the rooftops at the far right. At 11:41 the light is bright and summery, and the oranges glow against the deep green leaves.
